newsitem.title: USA: Niagara Mohawk to delay 1996 net, payouts.
newsitem.headline: Niagara Mohawk to delay 1996 net, payouts.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp said Thursday it will delay reporting 1996 fourth-quarter and year-end results and declaring first quarter preferred stock dividends due to the unresolved nature of continuing talks with independent power producers (IPPs) and related accounting issues.
"We are hopeful that we can reach agreement on a framework for settlement with the IPPs in the near term," the company said of its negotiations with the unregulated power plants.
It pointed out the dividends are not payable until March 31, adding New York Stock exchange policies and its corporate charter permit declaration of these dividends as late as mid-March.
In January 1995, Niagara Mohawk suspended dividends on its common stock.
